row.name: Skyrise School on South Collins Street

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The caregiver used their hand to push a child on their forehead.

Pest Extermination in Areas Where Children Present Treated Only if Allowed on Label: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The label provided a keep out of reach of children warning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pest Extermination in Areas Where Children Present Treated Only if Allowed on Label (26 TAC §746.3429(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The child was left in the preschool three classroom unsupervised for 29 minutes. The child was asleep during the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of the ten children records reviewed did not have updated immunization record on  file.

AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in noncompliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. A child had an allergic reaction while in care at the operation on 04/11/2023. This reaction resulted in the child needing and receiving medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: There were caregivers taking care of toddlers and infants that did not have training for "Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma, understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS), and "Understanding early childhood brain development"
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: There was not a written activity plan up to date in any of the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: There were child seen climbing and not having their feet on the floor and caregivers were not redirecting the children in any manner. There were also children seen jumping on their cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregiver at the operation did not display good judgment or self-control when inappropriately grabbing children. Staff at the operation did not use good judgment in not reporting concerning behaviors of a caregiver to the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: Incident report received did not contain at least the same information as Form 7239.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined the operation failed to notify parents of three additional COVID-19 cases at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease (26 TAC §746.307(d))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: This standard was part of an investigation.  It was determined the operation did not notified Childcare Regulation timely of a communicable illness.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
